About me

I see brands as stories waiting to be told differently.

I'm a branding and marketing professional with a curious mind, a creative perspective, and an interest in understanding what makes people connect with brands.

With a background in Branding & Advertising, I'm drawn to the intersection of consumer psychology, research, strategy and storytelling. I enjoy exploring different industries, understanding audiences, spotting creative opportunities and finding fresh ways for brands to communicate.

My experience across independent projects and agency environments has shaped me into someone who can think creatively while bringing structure, people and ideas together. I'm interested in how a brand thinks, how it speaks, what makes it different, and how creativity can turn that difference into something people remember.
